notes.purpose: Example MCP client configuration for connecting a local agent or CRM workflow to MachineSignal tools.
notes.working_directory: Run from the repository root, or replace the relative adapter path with an absolute path.
notes.normal_sandbox_flow: Call create_sandbox_customer first. The adapter stores the sandbox customer API key in memory and does not return the full key to the client.
notes.optional_customer_key: Set MACHINESIGNAL_CUSTOMER_API_KEY only when a pre-created customer key should be used.
guardrails: No real payment is executed in beta.
No external contact is executed in beta.
Full API keys are not returned to the MCP client.
